name: Assassin’s Grace (Combat)
body:
You are very adept at dealing a finishing blow.

Prerequisite(s): sneak attack +5d6

Benefit(s): You may deliver a coup de grace against a target that is unaware of you, even if they are not helpless. You only add half the minimum damage that could be dealt by your sneak attack dice to the coup de grace DC when using this feat. The target must be completely unaware that you are a threat, abilities such as uncanny dodge can foil this feat, as can the target being aware of an invisible threat.
